name: p3_glioma_mgmt
outcome_definition: Binary MGMT promoter methylation status (Methylated=1 vs Unmethylated=0) from CaPTk-derived structural mpMRI (FLAIR/T1/T1GD/T2) radiomic features over CaPTk's automatic tumor-region segmentation (edema/enhancing tumor/necrotic core). A molecular-characterization proxy task, not tumor segmentation or grade/subtype classification as the spec's P3 task calls for. Research-only, per spec FR-033.
